post.description: Run one source (``source``) or all ingestible sources (omitted).

get.description:
Public read: display-resolved languages across all locale documents.

Languages are collected from every stored document (deduplicated by
language+proficiency) and resolved for ``locale``. Returns an
empty list — never 404 — when no portfolio exists yet.

Deep readiness: 503 when the database cannot serve queries.

`/api/health` stays a cheap liveness probe; orchestrators and load balancers
should gate traffic on this endpoint instead.
